_schema: Workflow definitions for the automation engine (docs/013_Automation.md). Steps run sequentially; each step is retried up to max_retries on failure; on_failure 'continue' records the failure and proceeds, 'abort' stops the workflow.

weekly_full_run.description: Full refresh after the Wednesday EIA release: pull data, recompute every signal, revalidate, and re-issue the strategy view.

quick_signal.description: Fast intraday re-read without re-pulling EIA data: composite, risk, confidence, monitoring.

watch_cycle.description: Watch-mode cycle: refresh data + signal stack for the Discord feed. Skips the slow panel engines (backtest/replay/gate_sweep run on the daily and weekly cadences). The trade ledger is NOT a step here - it is re-simulated in watch.py immediately AFTER the signal row is captured, so it always sees the current cycle rather than the previous one.

daily_validation.description: Daily research validation, run once per morning report. Rebuilds the simulated trade ledger from the live signal log and re-sweeps the entry gate across the out-of-sample panel. Research only (doc 010 invariant 6) - never feeds production decisions. Exists so that 'how many trades has the signal produced' is answered by an artifact on a schedule, not by remembering to ask.
